NEWS 


FROM THE MONTREAL YMCA 


1441 DRUMMOND ST., MONTREAL 
TELEPHONE 849-5331, EXT. 57 


April lth, 1965 


Y.M.C.A. DRIVE AT 75% 

"The Y campaign has reached 75.3% of it's minimum objective" 
Robert Hopve, campaign chairman announced today at a workers ' 
rally. 

"xcellent progress has been made towards our hizher objective 
this year. Althouch reports from some captains and workers are 
running a bit behind schedule, we are confident that our minimum 
objective is attainable" 

Mr. Hoppe urged all canvassers to complete remaining calls, as 
soon as possible. "The response of our citizens to-date has been 
most gratifyinz, and we are hopeful that those not yet contacted 
will help us close the vital gap" 

Northmount end Westmount divisions still lead with 88% and 
84% of their objectives attained to-date.

at V1 9-5331 - Local 38. 
I am sure you will find him most helpful.
